description: Three pipeline jobs in Jenkins are currently failing and blocking the development team: payment-service-ci, user-auth-service, and inventory-api-build. Each pipeline has a different configuration or scripting error. Your job is to diagnose the root cause of each failure by examining the build console output, then fix each pipeline so that all three build successfully. After fixing each pipeline, trigger a new build to confirm the fix works. Jenkins URL: http://localhost:8080 — Login: admin / Admin123!
